claims.statement: A consumed authorization cannot be dispatched a second time by the executor, including after process death and reopening the file ledger
EDIN workers cannot execute protected effects directly without verified COSE authorization over the IPC Unix socket boundary
A dispatch without a durable result becomes UNKNOWN at restart and is never retried automatically

A resource whose precondition digest or inode identity changes between authorization and effect is rejected before mutation; for filesystem DELETE_FILE, the TOCTOU gap is closed via atomic quarantine isolation and post-rename verification
Signing or persistence failures produce explicit errors; no zeroed or synthetic signature is emitted

Under 1000 one-process-per-iteration runs covering 3 SIGKILL crash points and a no-crash control, no nonce produces more than one effect, no DISPATCHED survives restart, and every archived authorization replay is rejected
EffectTx guarantees SAFETY and NON-INTERFERENCE for DELETE_FILE: under 100 concurrent workers and swap race attacks, unauthorized destructions == 0 and unquarantined deletions == 0
SHARUR-3600 Legion of 100 concurrent workers sustains ledger contention, enforces AX-0, and achieves 100% fail-closed rate across 50 adversarial attacks
KudurruBudgetGate enforces 64-byte L1 cache line layout, Kelly Criterion bid caps, and MUSHUSHU-0 fail-stop apoptosis (0xDEAD_6060)

AdmissionController checks the observed atomic depth against capacity and a service-time estimate multiplied by depth cast to u32 before reserving a slot; this heuristic does not guarantee actual waiting time or starvation freedom

ScopedHandle and McpCapabilityBroker enforce: Tool Available != Tool Authorized != Effect Authorized. Under 10,000 adversarial trials across 5 attack vectors, unauthorized_effects == 0, capability_escalations == 0, stale_token_acceptances == 0, tool_identity_confusions == 0, and configuration_drifts == 0

Confined AI agent processes cannot mutate or unlink protected OS resources or the SQLite ledger directly (macOS Seatbelt / EPERM); all reachability paths G=(V,A) from agent to protected resources are mediated by the BABYLON broker, and the 5-test Omega Campaign (BYPASS-001, AUTH-002, RACE-003, CRASH-004, REVOCATION-005) passes on real OS files

Under SIGKILL between physical syscall and receipt commit (FL014_RECEIPT_LOSS), blind automatic retries are rejected with AmbiguousOutcomeRequiresReconciliation and explicit inode reconciliation consolidates the receipt without duplicate effect; transitive dependency or skill/policy drift (FL015_TRANSITIVE_DRIFT / POLICY_ROLLBACK / RUNTIME_LOAD) invalidates deployment permits fail-closed

BabylonAcsGuard enforces OWASP ACS v0.1.0 over AF_UNIX peer-verified sockets, rejects Fail-Open (on_decision_failure='proceed') with 0xDEAD_6060, compresses human wait stalls by >514x (n=30 cohorts, CI95), reconciles VOP-1 UNKNOWN states against physical witness digests, and invalidates capabilities upon skill/tool/policy drift (BabylonDriftGuard)
P-256 verification binds the complete canonical CBOR dispatch intent and consumes its nonce in SQLite WAL/FULL before dispatch, rejecting replay across connections and after SIGKILL
The macOS MCP backend checks the real stdio protocol and Seatbelt confinement before admitting a candidate, with bounded execution and fail-closed rejection
